To make this app baby proof extra buttons and menus have been removed, and no ads to tap on makes this perfect for toddlers!

Tap and drag to set off a string of fireworks! Handles multi-touch so you can set off fireworks by tapping all your fingers at once!

These fireworks are easy enough for babies to use and fun for adults too. Enjoy these amazing fireworks!

If you like this fireworks app (and are feeling generous) please rate the app.

Live transformation of your voice with different effects.

Apply real time audio effects on your microphone and transmit the audio signal to remote Bluetooth, airplay speakers, or to your device speaker or headset.

Very simple to use: just pick an effect, adjust its intensity and start transmitting your modified microphone signal to remote speakers, or to your device speaker or headset.

Special features:
- 4 live effects: normal, pitch modification, robot and echo
- All effects are adjustable
- Control the input and output levels to avoid Larsen effect
- Transmit the modified audio signal to remote Airplay or Bluetooth speakers
- Transmit the modified audio signal to your device speaker or headset
- Continue using the effect and transmitting while the app is in the background
